scripts.build: npm run build -w @edugestor/shared && npm run build -w @edugestor/api && npm run build -w @edugestor/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @edugestor/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @edugestor/shared" "npm run dev -w @edugestor/api" "npm run dev -w @edugestor/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @edugestor/shared && npm run typecheck -w @edugestor/api && npm run typecheck -w @edugestor/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @edugestor/shared && npm run test -w @edugestor/api && npm run test -w @edugestor/web
